overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by listing an executive session topic under Purpose 3 without identifying the litigation matter or showing a reasonable basis for withholding it, and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Sept. 15 meeting notice described the executive session topic (Purpose 3, collective bargaining or litigation) with insufficient specificity.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, we find that the Board failed to describe the executive session topic in as much detail as possible when it failed to identify the litigation matter to be discussed, and failed to demonstrate a reasonable basis for withholding identification of the litigation matter.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
